name: neuroschema.org
description: Static catalog of neuroscience ontologies and schemas, with automated evaluation.

scripts.quality:preview: PREVIEW=1 OOPS_IMAGE=neuroschema/oops ROBOT_IMAGE=neuroschema/robot SKIP_OOPS_WEB=1 node scripts/quality.mjs
scripts.images: docker build -q -t neuroschema/oops docker/oops && docker build -q -t neuroschema/robot docker/robot
scripts.ingest: cd backend && uv run python -m catalog_api.ingest
scripts.api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn catalog_api.app:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.mcp:stdio: cd backend && uv run python -m catalog_api.mcp_server
